ash.diffEditor.statusBar.help: The status bar follows the focused side of the comparison. Activate the position entry to go to a line or column. Use Left and Right arrows in the status bar and Enter to run an action. Indentation, encoding, line endings, and language actions open a picker; Escape cancels it. Reopen with Encoding suggests a detected encoding. Default encoding and automatic detection can be configured per language. Line endings can only be changed on a writable side, and the change can be undone.
ash.accessibility.editorSaveRecovery: Save failures offer recovery actions in a dialog. Use Tab to choose Overwrite, Retry with administrator permission, Save As, or Revert when available, and Enter to run the selected action. Escape cancels and preserves your unsaved changes. Overwrite makes a read-only file writable; Revert discards unsaved changes.

ash.dropOrPaste.accessibilityHelp: <keybinding:editor.action.pasteAs> lets you choose a paste action. <keybinding:editor.action.pasteAsText> pastes plain text. After pasting or dropping content, <keybinding:editor.changePasteType> or <keybinding:editor.changeDropType> opens the available actions and preferred-action settings. Escape returns to the editor.

Focus the status bar and use Left and Right arrows to select an action, then Enter to run it. Indentation, encoding, line endings, and language actions open a picker; Escape cancels it.
